evals.prompt: Write release notes. History v2.5..v2.6: 'fix: budget check off-by-one (#412)', 'refactor: move helpers', 'feat(api): retry on 429 (#390)', 'chore: bump deps'.
evals.expected_output: Grouped notes under Fixed and Added. The refactor and the chore are dropped. Issue numbers kept. One sentence per change, user-visible effect named.
assertions: Four heads or fewer, empty heads skipped

evals.prompt: Write release notes. History contains 'feat(db)!: rename users.email to users.login'. Migration: run scripts/migrate-login.ts once.
evals.expected_output: A Breaking head with the rename and the migration step in the same entry or the next line.
